FMI.name: Forceps minor
FMI.description: Frontal callosal fibers linking the hemispheres. Forceps minor is one of the pathways discussed in SCC DBS targeting; this public anatomical bundle does not reconstruct an individual therapeutic intersection.

C_PO.name: Cingulum (parolfactory segment)
C_PO.description: The anterior, parolfactory subdivision of the cingulum, shown to improve anatomical context around the subcallosal region. It is a population bundle, not the exact SCC stimulation pathway.

C_FPH.name: Cingulum (frontal–parahippocampal)
C_FPH.description: A cingulum subdivision spanning frontal and parahippocampal regions. It supplies extended limbic-network context; it is not evidence of a direct DLPFC–sgACC connection or a validated TMS route.

C_PHP.name: Cingulum (parahippocampal–parietal)
C_PHP.description: A posterior cingulum subdivision linking parietal and parahippocampal regions. Optional context for the broader limbic network, not an established stimulation target for depression or OCD.

C_PH.name: Cingulum (parahippocampal segment)
C_PH.description: The parahippocampal subdivision of the cingulum. This extends the available limbic anatomy beyond the previous frontoparietal segment; its presence does not establish a treatment-specific pathway.

FAT.name: Frontal aslant tract
FAT.description: An oblique frontal pathway joining inferior-frontal and superior-medial frontal regions. Included as frontal control-network anatomy alongside pre-SMA research; it is distinct from the STN hyperdirect pathway and is not a proven OCD treatment tract.

VTAPP.name: VTA projection pathway (slMFB model)
VTAPP.description: The DBS atlas’s VTA projection pathway, originally released as vtaPP_slMFB. It supplies an anatomical model for the slMFB view. Its full trajectories include caudal extensions; it is not a patient-specific depression response tract or the classical MFB.

MFB.name: Classical medial forebrain bundle
MFB.description: The separately released classical MFB model. It is included to make the anatomical distinction from the superolateral/VTA projection model visible; it should not be read as the depression DBS target itself.

STN_ASSOC.name: Associative STN pathways
STN_ASSOC.description: The DBS atlas’s associative STN tractography family. It provides frontal–subthalamic context for OCD DBS. Its full extent is not a separately validated amSTN target or a symptom-response map.

STN_LIMBIC.name: Limbic STN pathways
STN_LIMBIC.description: The DBS atlas’s limbic STN tractography family. These reference connections help orient the emotional and motivational circuitry discussed in OCD DBS, without claiming that the entire bundle mediates clinical improvement.

HDP_PRE_SMA.name: Pre-SMA–STN pathway (estimate)
HDP_PRE_SMA.description: Original STN atlas streamlines with endpoints in the estimated pre-SMA region and STN. This anatomical subset illustrates the hyperdirect connection discussed in inhibitory-control and OCD TMS research. It is an approximate atlas selection, not Ji’s individual connectivity target.

OCD_RESPONSE.name: OCD response-associated fibers (Li 2020)
OCD_RESPONSE.description: Positive-weight fibers from Li’s released OCD DBS response atlas. Negative-weight fibers are excluded. These are normative response associations, not patient axons, a significance map, or proof that every displayed trajectory is a pure STN hyperdirect connection.

ITP.name: Inferior thalamic peduncle (local segment)
ITP.description: The local inferior thalamic peduncle segment delineated in the human hypothalamic atlas. This shaded volume locates the small white-matter structure discussed in OCD DBS; it does not trace the entire thalamic–cortical course or show a patient stimulation field.

sources.label: DIPY · 80-bundle atlas
sources.review: Released forceps-minor streamlines, header space, bundled README and CC BY 4.0 license inspected. Garyfallidis et al., NeuroImage 2018; Yeh et al. 2018.

sources.label: Middlebrooks 2020 · DBS atlas
sources.review: Original bilateral MAT files and STN volumes from official Lead-DBS 3.2.1; MNI2009b coordinates. Source atlas terms retained. V2.2 protocol clarifies that vtaPP_slMFB is the VTA projection pathway, separate from classical MFB.

sources.label: Pre-SMA–STN · anatomical estimate
sources.review: Original motor/associative STN streamlines retained only when their superior endpoint is in AAL3 anterior SMA and the other in the bundled STN mask. Cross-template native affines; no nonlinear registration or Ji-specific target reconstruction.

sources.label: Neudorfer 2020 · hypothalamic atlas
sources.review: Bilateral inferior thalamic peduncle volumes from the official Lead-DBS atlas; native MNI2009b affine, threshold >0.5. This is a local tissue boundary, not an end-to-end tractogram.
